verdict.rationale: Kick documents role-based access control that decides who can see and do what in a workspace. Its docs also describe the accountant working inside the books: adjusting the Chart of Accounts, then reviewing, closing and locking periods. That supports accountant collaboration with scoped permissions, but the invite flow and the specific roles are not shown. Missing for 10: a documented invite workflow for external users, the specific roles and their permission scopes (for example an accountant or bookkeeper role), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books

citations.quote: Kick uses role-based access control so you decide exactly who can see and do what in your workspace.
you or your accountant can adjust it from there: adding, renaming, or restructuring accounts as needed
When your accountant finishes reviewing and closing a period, they lock it.
